id: title:Gilbert09:stop empty repo 409 from crashing fan out endpoint syncs

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion resilience: P1.F1.H1 adds an exception handler for GithubEmptyRepositoryError in the warehouse connector, allowing the ingestion pipeline to gracefully handle GitHub API 409 responses for empty repositories rather than propagating an unexpected exception.
review.reason: The supplied hunk P1.F1.H1 demonstrates a localized, bounded change: adding a specific exception handler and its corresponding unit test. This is a maintenance and reliability improvement rather than a broad systemic capability. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation of this specific behavior, not on unverified adoption or broader impact.
review.uncertainty: Only the supplied hunk P1.F1.H1 is available; no other hunks, PR metadata, or release notes are provided, so broader change context and complete implementation are unavailable. The tier assumes the supplied hunk represents the complete implementation of this behavior.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, PR metadata, or release notes are provided, so broader change context and complete implementation are unavailable.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception handler for GithubEmptyRepositoryError in github.py, returning early when the GitHub API returns a 409 status for an empty repository, and adds a corresponding unit test.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent warehouse ingestion failures when GitHub reports an empty repository, allowing the warehouse connector to handle this specific API response without propagating an unexpected exception or failing the broader warehouse sync.
